# AI Automation Agencies

> Evaluate automation agencies using exception rates, retry behavior, support terms and the cost of completing a real business workflow.

Published by AY Automate.

## Guide
- [Workflow automation agencies: compare the cost per completed job](https://topaiautomationagencies.com/)
- [Estimate the cost of automating one workflow](https://topaiautomationagencies.com/worksheet/)
- [Automation agency pricing: fixed fee or retainer?](https://topaiautomationagencies.com/automation-agency-pricing/)

## Provider sources
- [AY Automate](https://www.ayautomate.com/case-studies): Workflow implementation. Builds AI automations and publishes delivery case studies. Give the agency one document that needs correction and time the review. Include those minutes in the unit cost.
- [WeAreBrain](https://wearebrain.com/ai-automation-agency/): Workflow integration. Offers workflow automation and integration. Test two suppliers replying to one dispatch request. Count how many assignments and customer notifications the workflow creates.
- [Goodspeed](https://goodspeed.studio/n8n-agency): Operations workflows. Describes n8n workflows and AI agents for operations teams. If the quote includes training, ask staff to modify a live-style staging workflow and price their time in the savings calculation.
- [LowCode Agency](https://www.lowcode.agency/blog/ai-workflow-automation): Low-code delivery. Publishes a guide to AI agents that run business processes. Request the cost of adding one approval rule after launch. Include platform usage and any minimum support commitment.
- [Capgemini](https://www.capgemini.com/news/client-stories/zf-friedrichshafen-establishes-a-global-rpa-service-in-a-single-year/): Process automation. Documents the rollout of a global robotic process automation service at ZF. Ask for the cost of monitoring a backlog across two departments when only one of them supplies clean inputs.
- [IBM Consulting](https://www.ibm.com/consulting/artificial-intelligence): Technology integration. Offers artificial intelligence consulting. Simulate a downstream outage in the trial and ask who pays for repeated integration calls while the dependency is unavailable.
- [Slalom](https://www.slalom.com/us/en/services/artificial-intelligence): AI implementation. Describes AI consulting for enterprise teams. Request the volume and staffing assumptions behind a contact-routing automation. Count escalations that return to a human queue.
- [Deloitte](https://www.deloitte.com/global/en/services/consulting/services/engineering-ai-data.html): Engineering and data. Groups engineering, AI and data delivery in one practice. Have the agency include data cleanup in the estimate when comparing manual and automated processing time.
- [Accenture](https://www.accenture.com/en-us/support/state-texas-accenture-dir-artificial-intelligence): Enterprise delivery. Publishes an AI services offering under the Texas DIR contract. Compare the scope of the initial deployment with ongoing paid support. Ask for one example of a change billed separately.
- [BCG](https://www.bcg.com/capabilities/artificial-intelligence): Enterprise transformation. Combines strategy and applied AI. For a multi-team rollout, calculate the monthly benefit for one workflow before adding the expected savings from other units.
- [Remote MCP](https://topaiautomationagencies.com/mcp): search_firms, compare_firms and recommend_providers.
